rows.en: ...The Third through Seventh Angels...
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Deliberate opening noun phrase; next row supplies the predication.

rows.en: They appeared on the schedule in the Dead Sea Scrolls, and the EVAs annihilated them all.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Term provenance: Dead Sea Scrolls confirmed centrally from EvaGeeks; no exact Akurasu entry.

rows.en: But the Eighth Angel and those after it have yet to appear...
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Even allowing for some margin of error, there is no doubt events have begun to diverge from the writings.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Yes. That is why I assigned all three EVAs to #部隊名.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...Also to buy us time to recover the spear.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Continues Gendo's previous explanation; ignores stray closing wrapper.

rows.en: #部隊名 is precisely the problem. They have RahXephon...and Zeorymer under their command as well, do they not?
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: I thought you had authorized the assignment in full knowledge of all that?
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...Zeorymer aside, that mechanical god is under the influence of that old man.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Mechanical god refers to RahXephon; old man is Bahbem, but source designation remains.

rows.en: If it awakens, we will have far more than an enemy within to worry about.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Idiom rendered as an internal enemy, preserving escalation beyond ordinary betrayal.

rows.en: Even if there is no direct causal link, I cannot approve of bringing it near Central Dogma.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Term provenance: Central Dogma confirmed centrally from EvaOtaku terminology and Evangelion Fandom; no exact Akurasu entry.

rows.en: Indeed...The Mu may also take some action before we use the spear.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Could you not simply use #部隊名 as a decoy and bring back only the EVAs?
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Why must you invite a dangerous element into Tokyo-3?
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...They are a deterrent against any further interference that may occur.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: TERRA presumably assigned RahXephon with that same understanding.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...We still have no guarantee that Raideen and the other super robots will serve that purpose.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. That purpose refers to deterrence against interference; source does not yet guarantee it.

rows.en: Bahbem deliberately sent RahXephon in to ascertain that as well.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Yes...just as we permitted Zeorymer to exist.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Continues Bahbem comparison; restores committee as subject.

rows.en: Gathering these deterrents in #部隊名 follows your scenario, does it not?
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...That depends on the kinds of power gathered. They are merely one means of adjusting the schedule.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...Very well. I will not comment on your actions to date.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: In any case, with the Mu's appearance in this world...
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Deliberate cross-row unfinished causal setup completed by row23.

rows.en: We have been forced to commit in earnest to the other scenario.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Though that is the way things ought to be in the first place.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Do not forget, Ikari...We have no need of a "Tuner"...Nor, of course, of any new scenario you create.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Committee addresses Gendo as Ikari; Tuner kept as quoted role.
uncertain: Tuner is provisional source-literal role; no independently verified licensed English confirmed centrally.

rows.en: ...I understand. Everything will proceed according to SEELE's scenario.
rows.notes: Committee challenges Gendo's plans. Restores will proceed rather than retaining verbless source ending.

rows.en: ...Ikari, I hear #部隊名 has arrived in Tokyo-3.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: I see.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...Did the committee have anything to say?
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: They question our decision to invite them here.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: That is understandable. Their members are different from last time.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Their members refers to the visiting force, not the committee.

rows.en: And...#部隊名 must also be wondering why they were suddenly summoned here to Tokyo-3.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: There is no problem. I told them it was for EVA harmonics tests and trials of new weapons.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Harmonics test is source-literal technical compound; licensed English not independently confirmed centrally.

rows.en: ...Then what will we do about the spear?
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: We need not recover it ourselves. If we leave it alone, that will ease the old men's suspicions somewhat.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: But how will they react to what is about to happen?
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: It is unavoidable if we are to adjust our schedule.
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: So you are deliberately playing into their hands...
rows.notes: Gendo and Fuyutsuki discuss committee suspicion. Their hands means the committee's scheme; deliberate trailing reflection.

rows.en: ...It feels like it's been ages since we came back here.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Huh? Are you all heading out?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Broom gag setup; preserve question as spoken.
uncertain: Broom/four-re cultural gag preserved literally; localization review recommended.

rows.en: Ayato, you need a broom for that gag.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Broom gag explicitly required by Misato; no invented explanatory text.
uncertain: Broom/four-re cultural gag preserved literally; localization review recommended.

rows.en: And...four "re"s, too?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Preserves four repeated re syllables; gag requires cultural localization review.
uncertain: Broom/four-re cultural gag preserved literally; localization review recommended.

rows.en: Oh, so you do get it.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Broom/four-re cultural gag preserved literally; localization review recommended.

rows.en: Meg, what's that about?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Source nickname Meg stays distinct from Megumi.

rows.en: Beats me...Anyway, where are you all going, Asuka?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: We're having harmonics tests at NERV Headquarters. Well, it's like a routine checkup.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Harmonics test is source-literal technical compound; licensed English not independently confirmed centrally.

rows.en: A harmonics test measures your synchronization rate with your EVA, right?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.
uncertain: Harmonics test is source-literal technical compound; licensed English not independently confirmed centrally.

rows.en: That's right. Simply put, the higher it is, the better you are as an EVA pilot.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: But if you're going back to NERV, it looks like you're one person short...
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Ayanami said she had something to do, so she went back to headquarters ahead of us.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Ayanami refers to Rei; female pronoun supported by glossary.

rows.en: Oh...
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Come on, Shinji, let's go. I'll show you again today just how far ahead of you I am!
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Yeah, yeah...
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Well then...do your best on the test.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Ayato wishes Shinji success; restores do as instruction.

rows.en: I will.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Shinji affirms doing his best, following Ayato's wish.

rows.en: See you, Meg. So I'm sorry, but I'll have to cancel our plans to go shopping together.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Asuka cancels her promise to accompany Meg shopping, apologetically.

rows.en: I guess it can't be helped...You do your best too, Asuka.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Oh, Megumi. Sorry, but could you tell Haruka we'll have to postpone today's barbecue?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Misato asks Megumi to relay postponement to Haruka; request direction preserved.

rows.en: You were planning to go out for barbecue with just the two of you women?
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Two women explicitly specified by source, not inferred from names.

rows.en: And beer, too!
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. Cheerful musical-note tone rendered with lively exclamation under ASCII rule.

rows.en: Sigh...Misato and my sister really are birds of a feather.
rows.notes: NERV test departure conversation. My sister is Haruka, source sibling designation retained.
Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: ...This is me...
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: ...This object is me...the form that makes me who I am.
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Deliberate appositional form phrase retained; primary clause has subject/verb.

rows.en: But...I feel like I'm not myself...It's so strange...
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Subject/verb restored for feeling unlike herself and strange sensation.

rows.en: I feel my body melting away...My form is disappearing...I no longer understand myself...
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Subject/verb restored in all three clauses; self-understanding dissolves.

rows.en: I sense someone else...Who is there? Beyond here...
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Final positional fragment retained as source's echo after question.

rows.en: Who are you?
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: WHO ARE YOU?
rows.notes: Rei introspection during EVA-01 test. Katakana repetition distinguished with uppercase without inventing another speaker.

rows.en: How is it, Rei? How does EVA-01 feel after all this time?
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Ritsuko asks Rei about riding EVA-01 again after a long interval.

rows.en: ...It smells like Ikari...
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Ikari here is Shinji because Rei is in his EVA-01, not Gendo.

rows.en: Then, Rei, get out of EVA-01 and into EVA-00.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Ritsuko instructs Rei to switch EVAs; imperative preserves direction.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: Her synchronization rate is almost the same as in EVA-00, just like last time...No change.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Her means Rei, tested just before this report; sync rate compared with EVA-00.

rows.en: EVA-00 and EVA-01 had very similar personal patterns to begin with, after all.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Personal patterns belong to EVA-00 and EVA-01, not the pilots.
uncertain: Personal patterns is source-literal technical compound; secondary episode transcript corroborates wording, not licensed proof.

rows.en: That's precisely why she can synchronize with it.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. She refers to Rei; it refers to EVA-01.

rows.en: ...Then we should be able to carry out that plan soon.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. That plan is Dummy System, revealed in following fresh row80; no added name.
Silence retained.

rows.en: The pilots of EVA-01 and EVA-02 will be here soon. I leave the rest to you.
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Gendo entrusts remaining work to Ritsuko; no flipped request direction.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: NERV control-room test and plan discussion. Subject/action and source ending preserved.

rows.en: The Dummy System? I hate to say this to you, but I'm not really...
rows.notes: Maya voices ethical misgivings about the Dummy System to her senior Ritsuko; deliberate trailing qualification.

rows.en: I know you don't approve.
rows.notes: Ritsuko acknowledges Maya's disapproval.

rows.en: But we always need to be prepared. That's how people survive.
rows.notes: Ritsuko defends preparedness as necessary for human survival.

rows.en: I respect you, and I'll do my job. ...But I can't accept this.
rows.notes: Maya separates respect and professional duty from acceptance of the system.

rows.en: You're such a purist... You'll have a hard time ahead. Living among other people...
rows.notes: Ritsuko calls Maya a purist and warns that life among people will be painful; source trails off.
uncertain: Moral purity/taint metaphor rather than literal contamination; referent is Maya's future life among people.

rows.en: You'll understand that when you feel you've been tainted.
rows.notes: Ritsuko says Maya will understand that warning after feeling personally tainted.
uncertain: Moral purity/taint metaphor rather than literal contamination; referent is Maya's future life among people.

rows.notes: Maya falls silent after the moral warning; intentional silence.

rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Dr. Akagi.
rows.notes: Misato enters and greets Ritsuko with her surname/title; restored waiting object.

rows.en: What's wrong? It's a little gloomy in here...
rows.notes: Misato notices the atmosphere after Ritsuko's intervening silence.

rows.en: ...It's nothing. If I had to say, you were all so late that I got tired of waiting.
rows.notes: Ritsuko brushes off the question and blames the group's late arrival.

rows.en: Oh? I thought I was right on time...
rows.notes: Misato insists she thought she was punctual; trailing reservation retained.

rows.en: You stopped somewhere along the way, didn't you?
rows.notes: Ritsuko suspects Misato made a detour.

rows.en: Well, you could put it that way...
rows.notes: Misato reluctantly admits the detour; trailing admission.

rows.en: By the way, where are Shinji and the others?
rows.notes: Ritsuko asks Misato where Shinji and the other pilots are; restored location verb.

rows.en: I sent them straight to the EVAs. That's all right, isn't it?
rows.notes: Misato sent the pilots directly to the EVAs and checks Ritsuko's approval.

rows.en: You're awfully eager.
rows.notes: Ritsuko comments on Misato's eagerness to finish.

rows.en: Of course... #部隊名 is under orders to give half the crew a break right now.
rows.notes: Misato explains the squad has half-crew rest orders; exact squad placeholder kept.

rows.en: I want to finish work quickly and get some grilled meat and beer.
rows.notes: Misato wants to finish work and enjoy grilled meat and beer.

rows.en: That is an important occasion. But you'll still have reports to write after the tests.
rows.notes: Ritsuko dryly acknowledges the meal, then reminds Misato of post-test reports.

rows.en: ...And on top of that, the documents and bills that piled up while you were away total about 500 pages.
rows.notes: Ritsuko adds approximately 500 accumulated documents and bills from Misato's absence.

rows.en: F-five hundred!?
rows.notes: Misato reacts in stuttering shock to the 500-page backlog.

rows.en: That's the price of leaving the cleanup after Operation Yashima to other people.
rows.notes: Ritsuko links the backlog to Misato delegating Operation Yashima cleanup.

rows.en: M-my grilled meat and beer... They're getting farther away...
rows.notes: Misato thinks her grilled meat and beer are receding; thought kind preserved.

rows.en: Oh, Kaji was here too. If you finish work early, why don't you invite him along?
rows.notes: Ritsuko suggests Misato invite Kaji if she finishes early; sourced male pronoun.

rows.en: ...That's got nothing to do with it...
rows.notes: Misato dismisses the relevance of Kaji; object left broad rather than inventing romantic admission.
uncertain: Kaji's relevance is dismissed, but the source does not state the exact object of the denial.

rows.en: Come on, Ayato! Stop dragging your feet!
rows.notes: Megumi hurries Ayato during their shopping trip.

rows.en: What? You're the one who dragged me along on this shopping trip...
rows.notes: Ayato protests that Megumi dragged him shopping; trailing complaint.

rows.en: I couldn't help it... Asuka was supposed to come, but something came up. You should be honored to fill in.
rows.notes: Megumi explains planned companion Asuka became busy and insists Ayato feel honored as substitute.

rows.en: Hey, you've been having trouble deciding for a while now... What are you going to buy?
rows.notes: Ayato asks what indecisive Megumi intends to buy.

rows.en: W-what does it matter?
rows.notes: Megumi evasively says what she buys should not matter; stutter retained.

rows.en: Sheesh, you drag me along, and that's how you talk to me?
rows.notes: Ayato objects to Megumi's dismissive reply after making him accompany her.

rows.en: Oh! Hey, Ayato! What do you think of this tie?
rows.notes: Megumi asks Ayato's opinion of a tie.

rows.en: A tie? So it is a present for a man.
rows.notes: Ayato takes the tie as confirmation of a gift for a man; male recipient explicit in source.

rows.en: Just so you know, it isn't for you.
rows.notes: Megumi preempts any idea that the gift is for Ayato.

rows.en: Yeah, yeah, I know.
rows.notes: Ayato acknowledges he knows the gift is not for him.

rows.en: Oh, are you two on a date?
rows.notes: Miku encounters the pair and asks if they are dating.

rows.en: We're not!
rows.notes: Megumi emphatically denies the date.

rows.en: N-no, we're not!
rows.notes: Ayato also denies the date, stuttering.

rows.en: You don't have to deny it so fiercely...
rows.notes: Miku mildly protests their vehement denial; trailing reproach retained.

rows.en: What about you? Aren't you on a date with him?
rows.notes: Ayato turns the dating question back on Miku, pointing to Masato; source explicitly male.

rows.en: N-no, not really...
rows.notes: Masato hesitantly denies that he and Miku are dating; deliberate trailing denial.

rows.en: That sounds suspicious...
rows.notes: Megumi calls their denial suspicious; restored demonstrative subject/verb.

rows.en: W-we really aren't. This is my first time in this city, so...
rows.notes: Masato explains his first visit to this city, trailing into Miku's explanation.

rows.en: I was showing him around.
rows.notes: Miku supplies that she was showing Masato around.

rows.en: If it isn't a date, that's perfect! Miku, would you come shopping with me?
rows.notes: Megumi asks Miku to shop with her; speaker asks listener to accompany speaker.

rows.en: Ayato isn't much help... I'd like to hear a woman's opinion too.
rows.notes: Megumi says Ayato is not helpful and she wants a woman's opinion too.

rows.en: If you're sure you want me... What will you do, Masato?
rows.notes: Miku agrees conditionally, then asks what Masato will do.

rows.en: I'm fine. Why don't you go?
rows.notes: Masato reassures Miku and encourages her to go.

rows.en: Then I'll call you when we're done.
rows.notes: Miku promises to contact Masato when shopping is done.

rows.en: All right, I'm borrowing Miku for a while!
rows.notes: Megumi announces she is borrowing Miku; playful lengthening rendered lively.

rows.en: Good grief... She should've asked a woman to come along in the first place.
rows.notes: Ayato complains Megumi should have invited a woman from the beginning.
Masato pauses; intentional silence. Stray closing quote/@ indentation ignored per brief.

rows.en: Um... Ayato.
rows.notes: Masato tentatively addresses Ayato; intentional address fragment.
Ayato's questioning reaction retained as punctuation only.

rows.en: What do you... think of me?
rows.notes: Masato asks Ayato's opinion of him, after hesitating.

rows.en: What do I think...? We're friends in the same squad, aren't we?
rows.notes: Ayato reassures Masato that they are squadmates/friends.
Masato starts a self-directed objection and cannot finish; intentional fragment.
Repeated silence is reused across several original scene positions.

rows.en: ...It doesn't bother me. Besides, I know how you feel.
rows.notes: After an intervening Ayato silence, Ayato says he does not mind and understands Masato.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Masato reacts to Ayato's understanding; intentional reaction.

rows.en: When you're suddenly brought here and told to get into a robot and fight, you can't just accept it right away, can you?
rows.notes: Ayato explains that sudden recruitment and orders to fight in a robot are difficult to accept immediately.
Silence checked at all five original uses.

rows.en: And... from what everyone's told me, quite a few of them seem to have gone through something like we did.
rows.notes: After Masato's intervening silence, Ayato says others' stories show many similar experiences.

rows.en: Really...?
rows.notes: Masato asks whether the others really had similar experiences.

rows.en: Yeah. Kaine and his friends, Koji, Shinji, Hokuto, Ginga...
rows.notes: Ayato enumerates Kaine's group, Koji, Shinji, Hokuto and Ginga; deliberate list ending.

rows.en: Judau... seems a little different, but a lot of us have been in pretty similar situations.
rows.notes: Ayato qualifies Judau's case but reiterates that many have similar circumstances.

rows.en: Oh! Isn't that Ayato over there?
rows.notes: Mari spots Ayato while he is talking to Masato.

rows.en: Ayato, what are you doing?
rows.notes: Akira addresses Ayato and asks what he is doing.

rows.en: ...It sounds like Akira went through it too. Like us, he was told it was his destiny.
rows.notes: Ayato continues reassuring Masato, using arriving Akira as another example of imposed destiny; he refers to Akira.

rows.en: Ayato, didn't you go out with Meg?
rows.notes: Mari asks whether Ayato had gone out with Meg; source nickname kept distinct.

rows.en: Well, you can see how that turned out.
rows.notes: Ayato points to his present company as the answer; outcome implied by vanished Megumi.
uncertain: Ayato's visible situation answers Mari: Meg has gone shopping with Miku; reply does not explicitly explain her departure.

rows.en: Then why don't you come with us? Kaine, Ryoko and the others want us all to have a meal together.
rows.notes: Akira invites Ayato to join Kaine, Ryoko and the others for a shared meal.

rows.en: Yeah, sure.
rows.notes: Ayato accepts Akira's invitation.

rows.en: Do you want to come too, Masato?
rows.notes: Mari extends the meal invitation to Masato.
At i045b:160 Masato hesitates at Mari's invitation; at s0450:732 he begins a rescue resolve, continued at s0450:734 after Miku's question. Both require the open fragment I...

rows.en: Let's go, Masato. Everyone's calling us.
rows.notes: Ayato urges Masato to join the waiting/calling group.

rows.en: Okay...
rows.notes: Masato quietly accepts the meal invitation.

rows.en: Thank you, Miku. I picked out something lovely thanks to you.
rows.notes: Megumi thanks Miku for helping choose a lovely tie.

rows.en: You're welcome. By the way, that tie... Who's it for?
rows.notes: Miku acknowledges thanks and asks who receives the tie.

rows.en: Oh... um... Well... I guess it's for my superior officer...
rows.notes: Megumi evasively identifies her superior officer as the recipient; hesitation retained, no invented gender.

rows.en: Could it be Captain Bright?
rows.notes: Miku guesses Captain Bright as the recipient.

rows.en: No! Not someone in #部隊名, someone at TERRA...
rows.notes: Megumi denies Bright and contrasts a TERRA superior with someone in the squad; unfinished TERRA reference kept.
uncertain: Gift recipient is an unspecified TERRA superior here; no identity or gender added.

rows.en: That's lovely. I'm sure whoever receives it will be happy.
rows.notes: Miku reassures Megumi about the tie gift; recipient's gender remains unstated.

rows.en: You think so...? If I were more like my sister, it would work out, but...
rows.notes: Megumi compares herself with her sister Haruka; restores I and it; trailing doubt retained.

rows.en: Your sister? You mean Captain Shitow?
rows.notes: Miku identifies the sister as Captain Shitow, using sourced surname spelling.

rows.en: It's not that I hate my sister or anything, but...
rows.notes: Megumi qualifies her feelings about Haruka; trailing reservation retained.

rows.en: She may not look it, but she has a silly, girlish side, too.
rows.notes: Megumi contrasts Haruka's public appearance with her girlish silliness; no softening of silly.

rows.en: Captain Shitow does...?
rows.notes: Miku repeats the surprising identification; contextual question ellipsis retained.

rows.en: Yes. Apparently, there was a boy she really loved a long time ago...
rows.notes: Megumi recalls Haruka's former love; boy is explicit in source, not inferred.

rows.en: And... it seems she still can't forget him. Even at her age...
rows.notes: Megumi says Haruka still remembers that boy; age-related jab retained.

rows.en: Still, I envy her. Being able to keep loving one person so deeply...
rows.notes: Miku envies enduring love for one person; explanatory trailing sentiment retained.

rows.en: Captain, that's the restaurant.
rows.notes: Haruka directs Amuro to the restaurant; Captain addresses Amuro.

rows.en: Oh, right.
rows.notes: Amuro answers Haruka with hesitation.

rows.en: It might be a little early for dinner, but...
rows.notes: Vega qualifies the timing of dinner; deliberate trailing reservation.

rows.en: ...I have to decide our future unit assignments. I'd like to get back to the ship soon, if possible.
rows.notes: Amuro wants to return to handle future squad organization; both obligation and preference restored.

rows.en: It's all right. I've already asked Captain Quattro to take care of that.
rows.notes: Haruka has asked Quattro to handle Amuro's work; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Char's having a rough time of it, too...
rows.notes: Amuro's thought identifies Quattro as Char; thought fitting used.

rows.en: But why me?
rows.notes: Amuro asks why he was invited, continuing dinner context.

rows.en: Well, how should I put it...
rows.notes: Haruka hesitates over how to explain; deliberate trailing hesitation.

rows.en: With Haruka and me going, I felt we ought to invite you, Captain...
rows.notes: Vega says their pairing led her to invite Amuro; leaves the source's unstated reason unstated.
Amuro's standalone puzzled question mark retained.

rows.en: There they are! This is D-1. Target located!
rows.notes: Kaine locates the dinner trio; D-1 is his mock radio call, distinct from hostile D1.

rows.en: All right! Nice work, Kaine!
rows.notes: Ryoko praises Kaine's discovery.

rows.en: Whew! We almost lost sight of you.
rows.notes: Koji says the group almost lost sight of the trio; restores we and you from pursuit context.

rows.en: W-what's going on? All of you... together like this...
rows.notes: Vega reacts to the gathering; unfinished source observation retained with ellipsis.

rows.en: Vega, no sneaking off ahead of us, okay?
rows.notes: Judau objects to Vega sneaking ahead to dinner; no invented romantic accusation.

...Ayato...!
...Shinji...!
Shinji! Ayato! Answer me!! Shinji! Ayatoooo!!
N-no... Their signals can't have disappeared...!
rows.notes: Their refers to trapped units' sensor readings.

rows.en: D1 has entered the unknowable realm... Communications with RahXephon and EVA-01... have been lost...!
rows.notes: Megumi reports loss of communications and D1 transition.
uncertain: Unknowable realm is source-literal; exact canonical Dolem terminology unestablished.

rows.en: You idiots, don't give up!!
That's right! If that's how it is, we'll sortie ourselves!
...We're already too late.
rows.notes: Ruri says rescue deployment is already too late, not that the pilots are necessarily dead.

rows.en: Ruri!?
D1 isn't here anymore.
What are you talking about? It's right in front of us...!
That's probably a shadow.
rows.notes: Shadow means residual apparent D1 image; no invented hologram explanation.

rows.en: A shadow...!?
I think we should withdraw for now and work out a countermeasure.
B-but!!
The captain is right. As things stand, we have far too little information...!
rows.notes: Captain refers to Ruri, whose retreat advice immediately precedes.

rows.en: So we have no choice but to pull back for now...!
Then what about Shinji and Ayato...!?
We still can't contact them. At the very least, they don't seem to be on this side of the world.
rows.notes: Light cannot contact the two pilots; this side of the world retained.

rows.en: N-no...
D-does that mean... they might have gone to the afterlife...?
rows.notes: Ginga's euphemistic afterlife speculation is interrupted by Ryoko striking him.

rows.en: Oww! What was that for, Ryoko!?
You idiot! Don't say things that bring bad luck!
B-but... where on earth did those two go...!?
W-well, that's...
I think... they were probably thrown into another dimension or phase space.
rows.notes: Alternate dimension / phase space remain alternative hypotheses.
uncertain: Phase space is source-literal; Miku presents an uncertain alternative-dimension hypothesis.

rows.en: Can they get into that phase space, Makuu Space or whatever, and still come back?
rows.notes: Kaine muddles phase space with the fictional Makuu Space reference. Central root review supports exact capitalization through official Bandai English; no explanation of Gavan added.
uncertain: Phase space is source-literal; exact canonical Dolem terminology unestablished.

rows.en: That... I don't know...
Then you're saying we don't even know if those two are alive!?
Calm down, Ginga. Evangelion and RahXephon have life support systems.
I'm sure Shinji and Ayato are safe.
...Though there's a time limit.
Hayato...!
It's a fact, Michiru. If we rescue them after their life support runs out, it'll be too late.
rows.notes: After-life-support rescue is explicitly too late.

rows.en: Yeah... it's a race against time.
Then do we... have no choice but to just sit here and wait?
You saw that naval bombardment earlier. You know attacking blindly won't work, right?
Yes... It sucked every shot inside itself...
rows.notes: Every shot inferred from preceding naval bombardment.

rows.en: Damn it, that trash-can bastard is a real pain to deal with.
rows.notes: Crude trash-can insult preserved.

rows.en: ...Anyway, those two are to blame. They acted on their own and ignored the plan. They completely brought this on themselves.
rows.notes: Both independent action and ignoring operational plan retained.

rows.en: Especially Shinji! He gets just a teeny bit of a good result on that test, and now it's 'I'll show you how it's done'?
rows.notes: Asuka mocks Shinji's boast with quoted register.

rows.en: Hah! What a cocky show-off.
Hey, you can't talk about them like that!
Shut up! You're an even worse show-off yourself!
What did you saaay!?
rows.notes: Extended anger carried by stretched say rather than adding a new explicit swear.

rows.en: Idiot Shinji and Ayato got influenced by people like you and Ryoko, and that's why they screwed up like that!
rows.notes: Both bad influence and ensuing blunder preserved.

rows.en: Why don't you reflect on what you've done, just a little!?
You bastard! Are you picking a fight with me!?
rows.notes: Abusive confrontation renders teme without introducing a specifically gendered slur; final meaning/force correction, not compression.

rows.en: Stop! Fighting among yourselves won't do any good!
...That's right.
Well, this is a rare sight. She's actually stepping in to break it up...
rows.notes: She refers to Rei, sourced female in glossary; rare intervention.

rows.en: Maybe it'll rain tomorrow, huh?
rows.notes: Rain/spears idiom setup kept for Light's correction next row.

rows.en: You mean spears, spears. Rain wouldn't be anything to be surprised about.
rows.notes: Preserves spears joke rather than replacing both rows with a disconnected idiom.

rows.en: Oh, right...
...Miss Perfect, what do you think you're doing?
rows.notes: Miss Perfect is Asuka's hostile honor-student epithet for Rei.

rows.en: Does hearing people badmouth Shinji really upset you that much!?
...What about you? Do you pilot an EVA so other people will praise you?
No, not other people! I want to be able to praise myself!!
Stop it, both of you.
Misato!
...Yes, Asuka is right... They did act on their own. So when they come back, I'll have to give them a scolding.
rows.notes: Misato promises reprimand upon return, implicitly committing to rescue.

rows.en: ...Everyone, Dr. Akagi will explain the rescue operation.
Please gather in the briefing room now.
Understood.
You're going to salvage EVA-01 and RahXephon along with the Dolem?
Yes. It's the only method we believe is possible at present.
What exactly does it involve?
We'll drop all 992 remaining N2 depth charges on the target...
rows.notes: Exact 992 and existing N2 Depth Charge glossary term preserved; glossary provenance flagged.
uncertain: N2 Depth Charge follows glossary but glossary itself flags English provenance.

rows.en: Then, with the timing synchronized, we'll use the AT Fields of the two remaining EVAs...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished lead-in to next row's interference action retained.

rows.en: We will interfere with the Dolem's imaginary-number circuit for just one thousandth of a second.
rows.notes: Continues Ritsuko's AT Field interference plan from399; literal technical compound. Root approved literal wording with technical provenance limits.
uncertain: Source-literal technical compound; independently canonical English wording unestablished.

rows.en: Then, at that instant, we will focus the blast energy and destroy the Dolem's corridor.
rows.notes: Root approved literal wording with technical provenance limits.
uncertain: Source-literal technical compound; independently canonical English wording unestablished.

rows.en: But then, what will happen to the EVA and RahXephon... to Shinji and Ayato...?
rows.notes: Vega warns of both units and both pilots; source trailing concern retained as questions.

rows.en: I can hardly call that a rescue operation.
As I said earlier... this is the only method we can carry out within the time limit.
rows.notes: Ritsuko addresses briefing group, reiterating limited rescue window.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: Good grief. This is one hell of a gamble.
But if there's no other way, we'll have to do it.
Yeah. Like hell we're just gonna let Shinji and Ayato die!
We even managed to rescue Hokuto and Ginga after they were taken to Spiral Castle... I'm sure we'll work something out this time, too.
rows.notes: Judau invokes successful rescue of Hokuto and Ginga from Spiral Castle as reassurance.

rows.en: Yes. This time, it's our turn to help rescue them.
rows.notes: Hokuto switches former rescued group to rescuers; explicit we retained.

rows.en: Everyone... thank you.
Um... Misato?
...What is it, Masato?
Couldn't we use Zeorymer's Dimensional Coupler System to rescue those two?
rows.notes: Masato proposes rescue use of Zeorymer's system; Miku's intervening address at417 inspected.

rows.en: Huh...?
Masato...
Hey, isn't that a great idea?
What makes you think so?
Well, it couples dimensions, right? Sounds like it could rescue those two from that other-dimensional space they got sent to.
rows.notes: Tapp extrapolates from system name;423 Rose and421 Koji expose the name-based guess.

rows.en: You only thought that because of the name, didn't you?
rows.notes: Koji challenges Tapp's reasoning, not Masato's sincere proposal.

rows.en: Yeah.
Oh, come on! What are you talking about at a time like this?
...So, could we use it?
rows.notes: Masato returns to his unanswered practical proposal after Misato's silence.

rows.en: At present, the Dimensional Coupler System is essentially a black box...
rows.notes: Unknown internal mechanism, not a literal box.

rows.en: There are too many unknown factors for us to use it in this operation.

rows.notes: Intentional silence.

rows.en: ...I appreciate the thought, Masato.
rows.notes: Misato gently declines Masato's idea while appreciating his wish to help.
Trailing hesitant acknowledgement retained.

rows.en: ...Then what is our assignment?
The Mu may detect our movements and deploy Dolems against us.
rows.notes: Possible Mu response to the rescue team's activity.

rows.en: Please keep watch over the area and repel any enemies that appear.
...Understood. When does the operation begin?
In about two hours... at 1500. Major Katsuragi and I will command this operation.
rows.notes: 1500 retained as military time; source Major Katsuragi preserved.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry, Captain Bright. I know full well that we're overstepping our bounds...
rows.notes: Misato addresses Captain Bright about taking operational command.

rows.en: No, it's fine. You're the right people to take command here.
I'm grateful to hear you say that.
Then... you heard the plan, everyone. Take your positions at once.
Understood.
...Hey, Kyoshiro. Those N2 Depth Charges are incredibly powerful, aren't they?
rows.notes: Binding N2 Depth Charge wording, which glossary itself flags as distinct from mine/bomb.
uncertain: Binding glossary flags N2 Depth Charge versus series mine/bomb wording.

rows.en: Are we really going to be all right using so many of them?
As someone once said, "As though standing on the edge of an abyss, as though treading on thin ice"...
rows.notes: Source maxim translated directly; both abyss and thin-ice images retained. Final avoids adding an unsourced description of the quoted person.

rows.en: If our timing is even a little late, it'll wipe out not just us, but this whole city.

rows.notes: Wordless startled response retained.

rows.en: Even so, we can't just sit here and do nothing.
If there's even a one-in-ten-thousand chance of saving them, I'll take that gamble.
rows.notes: Literal one-in-ten-thousand probability retained, not generic long odds.

rows.en: ...That's how I've always done things.
You're right. If we stumble here, we won't be able to rescue Erika, either.
...Yeah.
Dr. Akagi. Your plan... what exactly is the meaning of this?
rows.notes: Private Misato/Ritsuko challenge after briefing.

rows.en: Our top priority is recovering EVA-01... even if its body sustains massive damage.
rows.notes: EVA-01 recovery has priority even with severe body damage.

rows.en: Hold on! What about RahXephon and Ayato!?
In this case, whether the pilots live or die is irrelevant.
rows.notes: Cold statement concerning pilot survival; no softening.
Wordless shocked response retained.

rows.en: Damn...! If we lose Shinji and the others, it'll be #部隊名's fault! Don't forget that!
rows.notes: Runtime squad placeholder exact; losing Shinji and others is squad's fault.

rows.en: Why are you and Commander Ikari so obsessed with EVA-01!? What exactly are the EVAs!?
rows.notes: Misato questions EVA-01 priority and EVA nature; source plural generic EVA rendered EVAs.

rows.en: Everything is in the documents I gave you!
That's a lie! Otherwise, the higher-ups would never have approved an operation like this!
Then are you saying we should use Zeorymer's Dimensional Coupler System?
rows.notes: Ritsuko counters with Masato's earlier Dimensional Coupler proposal.

rows.en: That system, designed to create an engine that runs forever, just like the S2 theory your father proposed...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing noun phrase extending455; perpetual operation and father's S2 theory retained. Engine restores the concrete power mechanism in the source.

rows.en: ...Misato, trust me for now.
...Second Impact, the Instrumentality Project, Adam... There are still secrets I don't know about.
rows.notes: Misato thought; three secret references retained; actual thought fitting. Root confirmed source-short Instrumentality Project from main full-term entry and EvaOtaku RCB glossary; no Human expansion.

rows.en: I see... That certainly is a reckless plan.
If we go on like this, we could put Ayato and Shinji's lives in danger. Itsuki... isn't there some other way?
Good grief... So it really is all about him, after all.
rows.notes: Him refers to Ayato by460 and next reply; gender confirmed by character glossary.

rows.en: I'm talking about them, not just him.
rows.notes: Haruka insists both trapped pilots matter; them contrasted with Ayato alone.

rows.en: It's the same thing. Besides, he's also the reason we broke up.
rows.notes: Itsuki invokes Ayato as the reason he and Haruka separated; no additional history.

rows.en: ...That's over and done with. Past tense.
rows.notes: Haruka frames old relationship as over; grammatical tense callback retained.

rows.en: Past perfect continuous, isn't it? No, I suppose it is for me, too.
rows.notes: Intentional grammar metaphor and self-directed coda retained.

rows.en: It's all right. I understand. That's why you joined TERRA... Time has stood still for you ever since then.
rows.notes: Time metaphor concerns Haruka's unresolved past and TERRA decision, not literal frozen clock.

rows.en: You thought TERRA could get it moving again, didn't you?
rows.notes: It refers to Haruka's stopped time; resumed movement explicit.

rows.en: Itsuki...
rows.notes: Deliberate bare name address retained.

rows.en: But I couldn't get it moving.
rows.notes: Itsuki says he could not restart Haruka's time.

rows.en: It wasn't your fault.
Even so, I wanted to get it moving. To help you break free of your past, too.
rows.notes: Time movement and release from past both retained; second phrase intentionally linked fragment.

rows.en: But... I'm always just a substitute. Wherever I go...
rows.notes: Itsuki describes himself as substitute wherever he goes; source trails off.

rows.en: Don't talk like that...
rows.notes: Haruka objects to Itsuki's wording; natural imperative for her fragment.

rows.en: I've changed since then. And you've changed too, Haruka. But he hasn't...
rows.notes: He is Ayato; contrast with changed Itsuki and Haruka.

rows.en: ...Stop it, Itsuki...
I'm jealous of him. In more ways than one.
rows.notes: Jealousy concerns Ayato; more than one meaning remains unelaborated.

rows.en: ...Please, we don't have time...
rows.notes: Haruka pleads for action because time is short.
Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: ...All right, Haruka. Then let me tell you what I have in mind.
rows.notes: Itsuki agrees to offer his idea; following480-485 key explanation inspected.

rows.en: There's one best way to open a closed door. You use a key.
rows.notes: Closed-door/key metaphor kept; no literal mechanism or unit identity added.

rows.en: A key...?
rows.notes: Echo question fragment retained.

rows.en: Yes. Another key that resonates with RahXephon.
rows.notes: Another key resonates; referent kept undisclosed.

rows.en: Could that be...!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished inference retained.

rows.en: I should tell you, this is just my intuition.
rows.notes: Itsuki frames advice as intuition, not established fact.

rows.en: Right now, there's practically no data to back it up. But it's better than doing nothing, isn't it?
...Um, #男愛称?
What's wrong?
Do you know where Akira went?
Akira...? Come to think of it, Captain Shitow asked me the same thing before I came here...
rows.notes: Source surname/rank Captain Shitow preserved; actor is lead asking about Akira.

rows.en: Has something happened to him?
I haven't seen him anywhere. He wasn't at the briefing earlier either...
Isn't he in his room?
But we've been ordered to battle stations, you know?
You never know. Maybe he's still asleep after the battle earlier.
rows.notes: Lead proposes Akira still sleeping after earlier battle; not definite.

rows.en: Then I'll go check his room.
...U-uuugh...!
...Akira... Akira...
rows.notes: Hidden thought label remains ???; repeated name only.

rows.en: W-who is it...? Who's calling me...?
rows.notes: Speaker and caller restored as I/me; caller identity not supplied.

rows.en: ...Akira... Listen to my voice...
rows.notes: Hidden label remains ???.

rows.en: Th-that voice...?
rows.notes: Interrupted voice-recognition fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Akira, a major turning point in your destiny is drawing near...
rows.notes: Ongoing approach of destiny turning point preserved.

rows.en: My... destiny?
rows.notes: Echo question fragment retained.

rows.en: Yes... And you must see it for yourself with your own eyes...
rows.notes: Refers to fate/turning point, not an imported identity.

rows.en: ...See it for myself...?
rows.notes: Restored see it for myself rather than bare source verb.

rows.en: ...Whether that person... will become your enemy... or...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished alternatives; unknown person is gender-neutral.

rows.en: W-what do you mean...?
Listen to that person's voice... Together with Raideen... And see for yourself...
rows.notes: Listen together with Raideen; no identity supplied for that person.

rows.en: Who is that person!? What is my destiny!? Tell me! Mother!!
rows.notes: Mother address explicit in source; hidden earlier speaker labels remain hidden.

rows.en: Akira! Akira, get ahold of yourself!
! M-Mari...
rows.notes: Akira recognizes Mari's voice; stutter and nonverbal exclamation retained.

rows.en: Are you all right, Akira...? You seemed to be having a nightmare...
rows.notes: Nightmare inferred from source unasa and Mari checking Akira waking.

rows.en: D-did I... fall asleep...?
...It was just as #男愛称 said after all.
rows.notes: Exact male nickname placeholder preserved.

rows.en: Now, hurry up and get ready. The operation's about to begin.
Y-yeah... I'll wash my face and be right there.
If you go back to sleep, I'll tell Captain Bright, you know?
All right, all right.
...That voice just now... It was definitely my mother, who died... What did she want me to...?
rows.notes: Akira explicitly recognizes deceased mother; last question trails off as source does.

rows.en: ...Where... am I...? This place seems familiar... That's right... This is Tokyo...
rows.notes: Location recognized as Tokyo in thought; no external timeline interpretation.

rows.en: Kamina!
rows.notes: Hiroko calls Ayato by source surname Kamina.

rows.en: Hey, Ayato.
What are you doing?
Asahina and the others... You're all safe.
rows.notes: Asahina is Hiroko; others present are addressed without changing source surname.

rows.en: ? What are you talking about...?
...What's going on here?
What do you mean...? Everything's the same as always.
The same as always...? But back then...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished reference to back then retained.

rows.en: Back when? What are you talking about?
Are you still half asleep or something?
...No way... Is this a dream...?
rows.notes: Ayato questions whether this is a dream; no factual answer supplied.

rows.en: No... Was everything up to now... the dream...?
rows.notes: Contrast questions whether prior events were the dream; no certainty added.

rows.en: Ayato...
rows.notes: Haruka's emotional name-only response retained.

rows.en: Haruka...? Why are you here...?
...Isn't this inside TOKYO JUPITER?
rows.notes: Exact location spelling TOKYO JUPITER from glossary.

rows.en: What year is it now? ...And why am I in Tokyo in the first place...
rows.notes: Question of year plus unfinished location question; no year inserted.

rows.en: ...But this is a dream... It's a dream, right? I couldn't possibly be here.
But this is just like the Tokyo I know... The Tokyo I lived in... With Asahina, Mamoru and the others, just like always...
rows.notes: Past Tokyo he lived in distinct from present comparison; unfinished everyday-life fragment retained.

rows.en: ...The world over there seems more like a dream...
rows.notes: The world over there is inferred from two-world comparison; seems like a dream remains comparison.

rows.en: That can't be... It shouldn't be possible, but...
rows.notes: Denial followed by uncertainty; trailing ending retained.

rows.en: What's wrong with that?
Whether you're dreaming of a butterfly... or a butterfly is dreaming of you, it doesn't matter.
rows.notes: Both directions of butterfly dream preserved; final wording avoids adding transformation into a butterfly. No claim about which world is actually real.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Ayato's surprise serves both Kim's bereavement and Reika's summons at use280.

rows.en: If what you feel seems real to you... isn't this the real world?
rows.notes: Conditional subjective reality argument kept conditional.

rows.en: ...I... guess so.
That's right. Isn't that a happy thing? You won't have to fight and suffer anymore...
rows.notes: Future release from fighting/pain proposed by Haruka; not asserted as past fact.

rows.en: You won't have to put up with anything, either. This is your world, as you feel it...
rows.notes: Enduring something renders gaman here after promise of no more painful battle541. Later545-547 hold back renders self-restraint in seductive argument. No extra object specified.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: You don't have to force yourself... Why not act like a man?
rows.notes: Source masculine exhortation preserved without adding explicit action.

rows.en: H-Haruka... What are you...!?
rows.notes: Interrupted question remains unfinished.

rows.en: It doesn't matter that I'm older. Don't hold yourself back. You're going to do what you want, aren't you?
rows.notes: Haruka older than Ayato is referent of older; source-directed pressure preserved.

rows.en: You're going to do as you please, aren't you?
rows.notes: Confirmation-seeking pressure remains question.

rows.en: No! I'm not forcing myself! I'm not holding anything back! I'm... I'm!
rows.notes: Denials preserve forcing himself and holding back separately; repeated I remains unfinished.

rows.en: You're a liar.
That's what you keep telling yourself, isn't it? Just like that child...
rows.notes: Unspecified that child remains gender-neutral; no dream identity imported.
uncertain: That child referent left unspecified; source scene does not name the child here.

rows.en: That child...!?
rows.notes: Echo noun phrase retained.

rows.en: ...Tell me, what do you want to do?
Can you "perform" yet? Can you "tune"?
rows.notes: Quoted musical verbs rendered perform/tune; no expansion into lore.
uncertain: Perform is a source-literal musical verb; exact licensed terminology not in current glossary.

rows.en: Has the "Star of Ra Mu" shone? Answer me...!
rows.notes: Star of Ra Mu exact glossary; past shone question retained.

rows.en: Perform... Tune...? The Star of Ra Mu...!? What is it... What on earth is it!?
rows.notes: Three musical terms echoed, not explained.
uncertain: Perform is a source-literal musical verb; exact licensed terminology not in current glossary.

rows.en: ...Where... is this...?
rows.notes: Thought fitted with thought=True.

rows.en: Shinji Ikari.
rows.notes: Name-only utterance deliberate; no clause added.

rows.en: That's me.
rows.notes: Self-identification replies to full name556.

rows.en: I am you. Everyone has another self inside them.
rows.notes: Dialogue between selves uses prefilled Shinji for both; no invented speaker label.

rows.en: The self is always made up of two people.
rows.notes: Two-person self explanation continues into560-561 beyond slice.

rows.en: Two?
The self that others actually see, and the self watching it.
rows.notes: Definition fragment answering two selves; contrasts externally seen self with observing self.

rows.en: There are lots of people called Shinji Ikari, too. Another Shinji Ikari lives inside your mind...
rows.notes: Other Shinji addresses original Shinji; multiple mental versions rather than physical copies.

rows.en: The Shinji Ikari in Misato Katsuragi's mind... The Shinji in Asuka Soryu's mind... The Shinji in Rei Ayanami's mind...
rows.notes: Source surname-plus-given names retained, without adding Langley absent from Asuka source.

rows.en: The Shinji in Gendo Ikari's mind. They're all different Shinji Ikaris, but every one of them is a real Shinji Ikari.
rows.notes: Gendo Ikari full source name retained; all differing representations called real.

rows.en: You're afraid of those Shinji Ikaris inside other people.
You're afraid of other people hating you...
You're afraid of getting hurt. And you shut yourself away inside yourself...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing connection to568 retained; you supplied.

rows.en: You go on living by turning over the tiny joys you've found, again and again. You keep deceiving yourself.
Everyone does that...! Everyone lives that way.
rows.notes: Original Shinji argues this is universal behavior.

rows.en: They keep telling themselves they're fine as they are. Otherwise, they couldn't go on living.
rows.notes: They refers to everyone in569; complete subject/verb supplied.

rows.en: That world has too many painful things for me to go on living in it.
Haven't you always shut your eyes and covered your ears to things you didn't like?
But I pilot an EVA and fight!
I really hate fighting, but I have no other choice...!
I had no other choice! They told me to do it!!
See? In the end, you're making excuses to yourself and running away. You've always done that.
You've even sealed away the memories of the truth you saw in the past, and you're running away from them.
rows.notes: Truth remains unspecified until Maya's later memory accusation.

rows.en: Memories... of the truth...!?
...Let's go back... I just... want to go home...
rows.notes: Ayato wants home; request to return retained.

rows.en: What are you saying, Ayato? Your home is here.
Huh...? Mom...!?
Is that child a friend of yours?
A friend...?
Sh-Shinji...!
...Is that your mother, Ayato?
Y-yeah... she is.
...I'm jealous. You get to live together with your mother like this.
Live together...? What about your mom?
My mom... long ago... in an accident...
rows.notes: Deliberately trails off on accident, does not insert death claim here.

rows.en: What kind of accident?
...I don't know... Besides, I don't even remember my mother's face...
Really?
Y-yes...
You don't remember what she did, either?
rows.notes: Question concerns Shinji's mother's profession.

rows.en: N-no...
rows.notes: English no matches Japanese affirmative response to lack of memory.

rows.en: I see. But I know about your mother.
Is that true, Mom!?
Yes. I've never met her in person, but she's a famous bioengineering scholar.
No... The mother I knew wasn't a scholar...
She was. 'Eva', born of 'Adam'... She's the one who proposed its basic theory.
rows.notes: Root reviewed original and neighbors: preserve quoted Adam/Eva symbolic names. No biblical explanation or acronym substitution added.
uncertain: Quoted symbolic Eva follows source; independent canonical English provenance unestablished.

rows.en: And... didn't you see the very moment your mother disappeared?

rows.notes: Shinji incredulously asks if he witnessed it; I restored.

rows.en: Yes... During an Evangelion experiment.
Mom, what are you...!?
...How... do you know that...?
rows.notes: Restored question how Maya knows the event from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Because you saw it and knew it.
That's a lie...! A lie, a lie, a lie! I never saw anything like that!
You've merely convinced yourself of that.
You've merely locked away inside your heart the tragedy you witnessed long ago.
No! My mother...
My mother was smiling...
If it hurts, you can stay here. Everything you want is on this side. You don't need to suffer through fighting anymore.
rows.notes: Maya offers refuge from both pain and fighting; all promised desires retained.

rows.en: You don't need to put up with anything, either.
But even here, I'm alone... Maybe the pain and sadness will go away, but I'm alone...
I don't want to be alone... I don't want to be here... I don't want to be alone anymore...
I see. Then, Ayato... you must listen to your mother.
You are RahXephon's rightful Instrumentalist... You were born that way.
rows.notes: Existing Instrumentalist title; rightful and born that way both retained.

rows.en: An Instrumentalist can only show their true worth by staying faithful to the score.
rows.notes: Musical score metaphor retained; singular gender-neutral generic Instrumentalist.

rows.en: Improvisation is still far too early for you. You understand... don't you?
rows.notes: Improvisation rendered musical common term, not an invented attack.

rows.en: You still can't even tune RahXephon properly.
But I can't blame you. So many things have troubled your heart.
